import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # species: strip extra spaces and normalize case (Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo)
    if 'species' in df.columns:
        df['species'] = df['species'].astype('object').where(df['species'].notna())
        df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip()
        df['species'] = df['species'].str.title()
        df.loc[df['species'].str.lower() == 'nan', 'species'] = np.nan
        # keep only allowed values, others -> NaN
        allowed_species = {'Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo'}
        df.loc[~df['species'].isin(allowed_species), 'species'] = np.nan
    # island: strip and title case (Biscoe, Dream, Torgersen)
    if 'island' in df.columns:
        df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
        df.loc[df['island'].str.lower() == 'nan', 'island'] = np.nan
        allowed_island = {'Biscoe', 'Dream', 'Torgersen'}
        df.loc[~df['island'].isin(allowed_island), 'island'] = np.nan
    # body_mass_g: text with commas -> numeric
    if 'body_mass_g' in df.columns:
        df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip()
        df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
        # out of range 2500-6500 -> NaN (rule)
        df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = np.nan
    # flipper_length_mm: ensure numeric and out of range check (170-235)
    if 'flipper_length_mm' in df.columns:
        df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
        df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = np.nan
    # bill_length_mm out of range 30-60
    if 'bill_length_mm' in df.columns:
        df['bill_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['bill_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
        df.loc[(df['bill_length_mm'] < 30) | (df['bill_length_mm'] > 60), 'bill_length_mm'] = np.nan
    # sex: missing means unknown; do not guess, just strip/normalize and keep NaN
    if 'sex' in df.columns:
        # preserve NaN
        mask = df['sex'].notna()
        df.loc[mask, 'sex'] = df.loc[mask, 'sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
        allowed_sex = {'male', 'female'}
        df.loc[mask & ~df['sex'].isin(allowed_sex), 'sex'] = np.nan
    return df

def answer(df):
    # average body mass for each sex, drop missing sex
    d = df.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    if d.empty:
        return {}
    g = d.groupby('sex', dropna=True)['body_mass_g'].mean()
    # drop missing group keys and convert to plain dict
    out = {}
    for k, v in g.items():
        if pd.isna(k):
            continue
        out[str(k)] = float(v)
    return out
